package_versions.MDFlexiComparisons: sourced directly from R/*.R (not installed as a package); no DESCRIPTION Version field consulted

continuous.columns: Log2FC, SE, stat, F, CI, CrI, AveExpr, PValue, AdjPValue

edger_f_floor.columns: F where |F_golden| < 1e-8; then stat, SE, CILeft, CIRight NA-ness is exempt from na_pattern
edger_f_floor.note: Port reproduces production: F < 0 gives NA stat/SE/CI (known_production_behaviour).

na_pattern.columns: NA positions in every column, except the edger_f_floor rows

if_threshold.note: Enforced now as the exact set of rows with PValue present and AdjPValue NA; the numeric threshold and theta get their own golden in PR-E2.

significance.note: Derived, not stored: no output carries a flag column, so the port's flag computed from its AdjPValue must equal the flag computed from the golden AdjPValue.

edger_ci_df.note: known_production_behaviour on every edgeR discovery run: the CI uses qt(0.975, df.prior + df.residual) (edgeRStatsFun.R:227-231), not glmQLFTest's df.total. The port reproduces it.

counts_ids_cols.columns: row counts, GroupId values, column names

actual_error: [MD_ERROR_START]Non-integer values detected in the count column. edgeR and DESeq2 require raw integer counts as input. Use de_method = 'limma' for pre-normalised or continuous data.[MD_ERROR_END]
warning_text: Column Description is not in the features metadata table and it will be added.
